localized.zh_cn: 木刻已修正：只接受一根法杖，完整保留其数据，避免多根输入时吞杖。
localized.en_us: Xylography accepts exactly one wand and preserves all its data, preventing lost extra wands.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 冷却核心适配新版：效果按游戏刻计时，高潜能的冷却周期最低为1刻。
localized.en_us: Cooling uses game ticks, with a minimum one-tick interval at high Potency.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 失稳晶体储存已修正：耗尽后的首次输入正常入账，采下的晶体保留内容。
localized.en_us: Destabilized Crystals accept the first input after depletion and retain their contents when harvested.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 灵气导流已修正：充能精灵保留施法者并避开友军，高潜能不再产生无效伤害。
localized.en_us: Charged Wisps retain their caster and avoid allies; high Potency no longer produces invalid damage.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 润饰扣费已修正：仅使用实际完成注魔的祭坛，失败时返还本次付款，不再误扣附近祭坛。
localized.en_us: Polishment uses the altar that completed the infusion and rolls payment back on failure, without charging nearby altars.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 疯狂魔导师生成已修正：巨脑僵尸的随机替换只在初次生成时判定，读档不重抽。
localized.en_us: Giant Brainy Zombie replacement is rolled only on initial spawning, never again on loading.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 反射核心扣费已修正：按真实等级和经验条计算余额，自动施法不能挪用主人的研究点。
localized.en_us: Reflection uses actual levels and XP progress; automated casters cannot spend their owner’s research points.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 信号核心适配新版：使用16种现代染料；信号烟花不额外造成烟花伤害。
localized.en_us: Signal foci use the sixteen modern dyes; their fireworks cause no additional firework damage.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 冲击核心已修正：正确读取核心的升级与消耗，爆炸遵守保护和生物破坏规则。
localized.en_us: Impulse reads upgrades and costs from its focus and respects protection and mob-griefing rules.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 魔导师交易已修正：关闭界面或奖励槽满时返还剩余物品，远离或激怒商人后不能继续交易。
localized.en_us: Trading returns leftover items when closed or full, and stops when the trader is distant or hostile.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 自然裂隙已修正：随机事件可正常产生充能精灵，坍缩进度会保存。
localized.en_us: Natural Rifts correctly spawn Charged Wisps during random events and preserve collapse progress.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 六方结构已修正：严格检查3×3范围内的八块邪术石，失败不扣魔力，拆除不掉落基岩。
localized.en_us: The Hex requires eight Eldritch Stones in its 3×3 frame. Failed assembly costs no vis; dismantling never drops bedrock.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 裂隙合成已修正：只消耗配方所需数量的催化物，不再吞掉整叠；储存的源质仍会全部清空。
localized.en_us: Rift crafting consumes only the required catalyst count, rather than its entire stack. Stored essentia is still fully emptied.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 星体监视器已修正：载体锁定并保存；目标离线或离开维度时清空旧读数。颜色节奏不再受帧率影响。
localized.en_us: Astral Monitors lock and save their carrier, clear stale readings for offline or out-of-dimension targets, and animate by game ticks.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 最耀者已修正：保存短路与攻击进度，读档不重置生命；最终短路只掉落一次，召唤失败后重试不重复扣精灵。
localized.en_us: The Brightest One saves combat and short-circuit progress without healing on reload. Final drops occur once; failed summons do not consume extra wisps on retry.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 扭曲汲取已修正：正确记录施法者与自笞效果来源，充能的威力和寿命可保存。
localized.en_us: Warp Extraction preserves the caster, power and lifetime of its charges and correctly attributes self-inflicted effects.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 原躯拆分已修正：肢体正常向外抛散，部分生成被取消或读档时不重复生成已产生的肢体。
localized.en_us: Protobody limbs scatter correctly, and successful limbs are not duplicated after partial cancellation or reloading.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 虚空高度适配新版：以当前维度最低建造高度为界；原躯在其下方16格拆分。
localized.en_us: Void boundaries follow the dimension’s minimum build height; Protobodies split sixteen blocks below it.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 引流注射器已修正：装满后不继续伤害，回充只扣实际接收量，并遵守PvP与攻击保护。
localized.en_us: Drainage Syringes stop damaging when full, charge only what the recipient accepts, and respect PvP and attack protection.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 红能思维适配新版：读取现代晶眼坐标；眼刻印可跨维度读取已加载区块，星体监视器仍限同维度。
localized.en_us: Red-Powered Minds read modern Crystal Eye coordinates. Eye engravings may read loaded chunks across dimensions; Astral Monitors remain dimension-local.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 碎片磨盘扣费已修正：每次成功喷出粉末立即扣料，中断使用不再免单。选料键可重绑，默认为Alt+J。
localized.en_us: Shard Mills pay for each successful dust shot immediately, including interrupted use. Selection is rebindable and defaults to Alt+J.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘议会
localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 银树磨盘已修正：装料必须匹配所选碎片，每次喷出立即扣料；嫉妒粉末读档保留归属与连锁层数。选料键默认Alt+J。
localized.en_us: Silverwood Mills require the selected shard type and pay per shot. Envy dust saves its caster and chain depth. Selection defaults to Alt+J.

localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 聚光核心伤害已修正：经过正常伤害、保护与死亡掉落流程。
localized.en_us: Spotlight damage follows normal damage, protection, death and drop handling.

localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 血腥教皇已修正：随从消失后解除相应减伤，范围攻击正常执行；攻击实际生效才回血或清除护盾。
localized.en_us: The Pontifex loses minion-based protection when minions are gone and performs area attacks correctly. Healing and shield removal require successful hits.

localized.en_us: Thaumic Concilium

localized.zh_cn: 物质剥离器已修正：保存准确中心，中心区块暂时卸载不会误触发坍缩。
localized.en_us: Material Peelers preserve their exact center and do not collapse merely because its chunk unloads.

localized.zh_cn: 教皇法袍适配新版：能力键可重绑，默认为Alt+L；染色配方接受任意黑色染料。
localized.en_us: Pontifex Robe abilities are rebindable and default to Alt+L. Dyeing accepts any black dye.
